textbookBox.concept: A rhombus is a shape with all four sides equal. Cut it into triangles and join two triangles to make new shapes.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A rhombus is a shape with all four sides equal. Cut it into triangles and join two triangles to make new shapes.
beats.speakEn: A rhombus is a shape with all four sides equal. Cut it into triangles and join two triangles to make new shapes.

beats.en: A triangle with 2 equal sides is called an isosceles triangle. Fold it in half and you will see that it has 2 equal angles.
beats.speakEn: A triangle with 2 equal sides is called an isosceles triangle. Fold it in half and you will see that it has 2 equal angles.

type: Key Concept: A rhombus is a shape with all four sides equal.
Rule: A triangle with 2 equal sides is called an isosceles triangle.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 maths · Shapes and Patterns · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: A triangle with all 3 sides equal is an equilateral triangle, and its 3 angles are equal too.

beats.en: A triangle with all 3 sides equal is an equilateral triangle, and its 3 angles are equal too.
beats.speakEn: A triangle with all 3 sides equal is an equilateral triangle, and its 3 angles are equal too.

beats.en: A triangle with no equal sides is a scalene triangle. Check whether any of its angles are equal.
beats.speakEn: A triangle with no equal sides is a scalene triangle. Check whether any of its angles are equal.

type: A triangle with all 3 sides equal is an equilateral triangle, and its 3 angles are equal too.
